title: Cold open — does Claude maintain my CRM by itself?
text: Someone typed maintain as if Claude tidies your CRM nonstop on its own. A skill called CRM maintenance runs one fixed routine per request, same input, same result. Does Claude check my CRM by itself? A skill is a folder Claude reads

title: Anatomy — a skill is a folder
text: Before it works. This one is CRM maintenance. It holds two items, a skill, MD file, and a reference folder. The skill MD is the full instruction set in plain language, no hidden logic. Claude reads it then acts. The file is the program.

title: Pipeline — how the skill works
text: The pipeline sits in the step section. Claude reads each step in order then runs it. Linear, no branching unless a step says so. Here's the part worth knowing. CRM

title: Mechanism — the interesting constraint
text: Maintenance is a specification written as an instruction set, not a standing job. It runs once when you ask and does exactly what the file says. Nothing runs in the background on its own. Ask the same thing twice and you get the same result both times. Ask for something the file doesn't cover and the skill has nothing to say about it.

title: Carry-out
text: Maintenance here isn't an ongoing job Claude runs by itself. It's one spec bound check, the same steps, the same result every time you ask. Your turn,

title: Your turn
text: Here's the prompt. Read it with me. Read the CRM maintenance skill in this folder. Before you run it, tell me exactly which steps it will execute in order and tell me plainly if anything I ask falls outside what the file covers. Claude CRM maintenance.
